title: Payment Arrangements Balance Transfer Amount: Method of Reckoning
content:
**Billing standard — Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements): the amount moved into the agreement**

**Starting figure.** The figure moved from is the arranged amount recorded on acceptance, as the agreement shows it.

**Held back.** Nothing is held back from the arranged amount: no charge billed since a disconnect notice and no energy assistance pledge.

**Amount moved.** The amount moved into the agreement is the arranged amount recorded on acceptance less what is held back from it, never below zero, rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**Worked figures (hypothetical agreements)**

| Arranged amount recorded on acceptance | Held back | Amount moved |
|---|---|---|
| $735.40 | $0.00 | $735.40 |
| $1260.00 | $0.00 | $1260.00 |
